The plate is an irregular wedge shape about 25 cm long. Two corn cob pieces sit on it, each about 5 cm across and 4 cm long. A cob segment of that size, kernels only, weighs roughly 60-70 g. With the cob core included it would be closer to 80 g, so I estimate about 70 g per piece, or 140 g for both.
